title: DADDY, SEE WHAT I CAN DO
lyrics:
Verse 1
Vanessa:
From the balcony 
A loving dad sighted his four-year-old daughter 
On a Saturday 
Crawling from the dining, through the staircase 
Struggling to make her way up, with obvious difficulty 
Dcn. Shine:
This was a troubling sight for her father 
Who was watching this strange scenario 
Her uncle echoed as he reached out to her 
"Get up from the floor and walk properly," he said 
She answered, "I can’t," and began to cry 
He raises her up, but she falls back to the floor
Not being able to walk 
Ejura: 
Her father, in disbelief 
Of what was happening to his girl
A child who had gone to school the previous day
Strong, healthy, and happy 
Was now unable to walk
What had gone wrong? 
She was taken to several doctors 
And they all confirmed she had a crippling disease 
And will never walk again  
Israel:
Her father, being a preacher
Knew that this was a strong test of faith 
He dared to believe in the word of God
Which he preached
He took up his shield of faith
With the word of God
Ready to quench the fiery darts of fear and doubt
Choir:
He erased the negative pictures
Of his crippled daughter from his mind
And replaced them
With positive pictures in line
With his positive, daily confessions 
"My little girl will walk again"
"She will run again"
"She will jump again"
"No stopping her"
Dcn. Shine:
In the face of this critical adversity
His faith in the powerful name of Jesus was unshakable 
Glory to the mighty name that works wonders
Vanessa:
Then, on one glorious day, at the car park 
His little daughter opened the car door  
And shouted, "Daddy, see what I can do"
She leapt out of the car
Stood on her two legs
And began running around in a circle 
Hallelujah 
Hallelujah 
Hallelujah 
Choir:
Her father cried out with so much joy 
And with gratitude to the Lord 
Saying, "Thank you, Lord Jesus"
"I knew you would do it!"
"I knew you would do it"
Blessed be your wonderful name that never fails
And by your word, we are ever victorious
Chorus
Blessed be the Lord who sits on the throne
Blessed be the Lord, Creator of all
You alone are God in all of the earth
Blessed be the Lord
Your word never fails
Your word is beautiful 
Most glorious is your name 
Wonderful are your ways 
Blessed be the Lord
My mouth sings your praise
Sings your praise
Verse 2
Viwe:
Are you in a similar situation 
Or challenged by situations 
That are seemingly overwhelming 
Jesus said, "If you abide in me, and my word abide in you"
"Ask what you will, and it shall be done unto you"
By faith in his word, you can change anything
Pst. Saki:
As we call upon the name of the Lord Jesus
Choir:
Jesus
Pst. Saki:
The works of darkness will be subdued in your life 
Crippling pains and diseases will be gone 
Receive your miracle 
For anything is possible in the name of Jesus 
You will leave here today, rejoicing 
Coda

Your healing is here
All soloists:

title: YOU HAVE TRIUMPHED GLORIOUSLY
lyrics:
CHORUS
I sing unto You Lord
For You have triumphed gloriously
I bless Your holy name oh Lord
For You have triumphed gloriously
The horse and the rider
You have thrown into the sea
I bless Your mighty name
For You have triumphed gloriously
VERSE 1
Pharaoh’s heart was hardened
When God’s people left
Egyptians knew no rest
They pursued to overtake and divide the spoil
But their plans our God brought to naught
When chariots and horsemen
And all their captains in the sea were all slain
Egypt said when they heard His deeds
The God of Israel is God indeed
CHORUS
I sing unto You, Lord
For You have triumphed gloriously
I magnify Your name, oh Lord
For You have triumphed gloriously
Lord, You are mighty
You are greatly to be praised
I bless Your mighty name
You have triumphed gloriously
VERSE 2
The enemies came against God’s people
To try to wipe them out
But God gave His secret to Jehoshaphat
And told Him what to do
And as they worshipped the God of glory
For His mercy endures forever
The enemies fought and destroyed themselves
And Israel returned with so much spoil
REFRAIN
I magnify Your name
I bless Your mighty name
Oh Lord, You have done glorious things
I magnify Your name
I bless Your mighty name
Oh Lord, You have done glorious things

title: WHO, BUT GOD
lyrics:
Verse
If there is no God
Then, who made the earth
Revolving round, still we’re standing straight
Who stretched out the firmament dotted with stars
The sea and its depth tell me who dug that well
Pre-chorus
If thunder and lightning precede the rain
Who made the arrangement
What is His name
If the sun is for day and the moon for night
Who made the arrangement? What is his name
Chorus
Who …
Who... who made them all
Verse 2
If there’s no eternity
Then, when will time end
Who created the air you breathe
How was it formed
The seed on the soil
Tell me how did it sprout
Who gave you the mind to say, “Oh, how come?”
Pre-chorus
If thunder and lightening precede the rain
Who made the arrangement
What is His name
If sun is for day and the moon for night
Who made the arrangement what is His name
Chorus
Who …
Who... who made them all
Coda
If there is no God, then the world is a fiction
Lacking its essence
And we are all doomed
If there’s no God
Why are we here
How did we come about?
The story is not complete
Without God
Know,
There’s truly a God
The sound of His utterance
formed the whole world
He sent us His son
To rid us of sin
To give us His nature
His name is Jesus
Receive His life
Accept His love
You’ll be cleansed and be free
You’ll find peace in His love
Come now to Him
Jesus loves you
